body.p: Below are MM notebook (NB) editorial guidelines for transcription, annotation, and (forthcoming) the glossary. We frequently update these guidelines to reflect our most current practices, so some points may differ from previous versions. For editors of previous notebooks: please note that we are no longer using either “quote” or “add” markup. [Last revised August 2026]

p.ref: Download the MMDA Transcription and Annotation Guidelines.

body.p: If you are editing a NB or assisting with the transcription, annotation, or proofreading of a notebook and have any questions, contact Cristanne Miller, ccmiller@buffalo.edu
